quote.translation: In positive teleological contingency, by contrast, it is the existence of "purpose without purpose" that is positively emphasised and witnessed.

quote.translation: In other words, within the two-membered structure "purposeless / purpose", negative teleological contingency lays particular emphasis on the first member, whilst positive teleological contingency places its stress rather on the second.

quote.translation: Consider the following newspaper report: "Yamada Isuzu, star of the First Film Company, was invited by the captain of the Isuzu of the Invincible Fleet to visit the cruiser Isuzu, then in port at Osaka, on the nineteenth, and was moved by the hospitality she received from Captain Yamada and the young officers.

quote.translation: On the twentieth she listened over the radio to the gallant scene of Captain Yamada of the Isuzu commanding the First Fleet's landing force at the naval review on the Osaka Castle East parade ground.

regions.text: 積狀と艦上における山田艦長との記念撮影の寫奥にサインして贈つたが、自宅にはこの記念撮影の引伸寫異を揚げて永くこの奇縁を記念することになつた』（照料九年+月ニ十ーR大阪朝日新爾京番度）。

quote.translation: That afternoon she sent Captain Yamada of the Isuzu a letter of thanks for his hospitality together with a signed copy of the commemorative photograph taken with him on board, and she has decided to hang an enlargement of this photograph in her home, so as long to commemorate this curious tie" (Ōsaka Asahi Shinbun, Kyoto edition, 21 October 1934).

regions.text: この場合、山田大佐が巡洋艦五十分の艦長に任命された動機は、山田と五十鈴との結合が目指されたものではない。

quote.translation: In this case the motive for appointing Captain Yamada to command the cruiser Isuzu was in no way aimed at combining Yamada with Isuzu.

regions.text: 然るに、山田を五十鈴との結合によつて映女優山田五十鈴と同名が現出した。

quote.translation: Yet the combination of Yamada and Isuzu produced the very name of the film actress Yamada Isuzu.

regions.text: それは全～目前々偶然に過ぎないが餘りにも著しい「目的なき目前」を有つをゐる。

quote.translation: This is no more than a teleological contingency, but it has an all too striking "purpose without purpose".
Had there been no actress called Yamada Isuzu, the contingency that Captain Yamada commands the Isuzu would have had almost no resonance at all.
